offer.say: Fifty carnivals. The banner says so, and it is ironed. The fifty-first must not be the one where the rink looked tired. Gus kept my gels upstairs. Coloured light, {owner}. It forgives a great deal.

options.text: I'll find the gels and get the lamps ready.
Why the gels? We could rent LED stage lights.
Is Kessler really not allowed to borrow them?
Spring is busy. Can it be a plain show this year?

why.say: Because the mothers in the stands skated under those same colours when they were six. You are not lighting a show. You are lighting their memory. Rent nothing.

kessler.say: In 1998 they borrowed the amber and returned it with a cigarette burn. The burn is shaped like Kessler. I do not believe in coincidences.

options.text: Then they'll never see it again. I'm in.

decline.say: A plain show is a practice with an audience. Very well. I will ask again when the lilacs come.

accepted.say: Pink for the little ones. Blue for the solos. Amber for the finale. The green we leave in the box. Nobody knows why we have it.

options.text: Found the gels. The lamps aren't safe to dress yet.
Everything's hung. Just the show now.

p_gels.say: Upstairs. The cupboard behind the piano that is not the Lindell's piano. Do not tell anyone I said that.

p_lights.say: Then make them safe. I will not have a clamp falling on a seven-year-old in a snowflake costume. The Clarion would never let us forget it.

p_show.say: Then I have nothing to ask you except that the ice is perfect. That is all I ever ask.

complete.say: Pink, blue, amber. The mothers cried. The fathers pretended they had something in their eye, which is a figure skating tradition older than the axel. Thank you. Now, the banner. It is still low. Shall we leave it there for the season?

options.text: Leave it low. People should see it.
Back up in the rafters. It's safer there.
Only if you iron it again.

c_low.say: Then the hockey players will have to look at it every night. Good. It will teach them something about edges.

c_high.say: Yes. Pucks have no respect for satin.

c_iron.say: I iron it every year. You think it irons itself? Leave it low.

done.say: Next year, fifty-two. Do not lose my shoebox.
